newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Semiconductor equipment makers cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Semiconductor equipment makers cut.

text.p: Alex. Brown said on Wednesday it lowered its rating on the shares of various semiconductor capital equipment makers, including Applied Materials Inc and KLA-Tencor Corp.
-- Alex. Brown said it lowered its ratings on Applied Materials, KLA-Tencor, Electroglas Inc, Lam Research Corp, Novellus Systems Inc and SpeedFam International Inc to market perform from buy.
-- It said it cut its rating on Veeco Instruments Inc to market perform from strong buy.
-- Further details were not immediately available.

-- KLA was off 2-1/2 at 40-3/4, Novellus was off 1-15/16 at 72, Lam Research was off 1-1/16 at 31-9/16, Electroglas was off 1-3/4 at 21-1/2, SpeedFam was off 3-1/4 at 30-3/4 and Veeco was off 1-1/16 at 33-1/2.
